policy: The certified June UK national battery declared as data (microcosm#611): the two build preflights plus the terminal battery. Every gate carries its thresholds as entry parameters at exact certified or receipted values; microcosm#630 landed the weighted-integrity pair as reviewed parameter edits with receipts in the entry notes, and the weight-ratio fence keeps its exact certified June value (the #630 breach was an SPI allocation defect fixed upstream in microcosm#710). The #680 stochastic layer delivers the take-up signal gate; every gate the UK runs today is declared below.

gates.notes: Frameless preflight mirror of the US cheap preflight: the committed coverage manifest must match the engine's current variable surface, aborting before source stages on graph or reference drift.
Frameless preflight over the materialized stage names: every family the coverage manifest marks required_at_build must have its build stage scheduled before any stage runs.

Ledger-compiled UK targets at the 2025 calibration period compared with the frozen incumbent registry surface. The signed list enumerates TCL additions, exclusions, unsupported rows, and vintage drift for review.

Ledger-compiled UK local-area targets at the 2025 calibration period compared with the frozen incumbent local registry surface. The incumbent's out-of-contract devolved private-rent and council-tax columns remain fixture-only and are signed with ruled rationales.

Structural, valueless local default-surface check: compose metric_names(area_type) over the committed local crosswalk roster and apply the signed area deferrals from local_target_reference_membership.json as reviewed exclusions.

Stage-time support-clip health gate over the WAS wealth receipt; raw FRS mapping stages have no imputation semantics and intentionally have no empty health gate. Allowances pinned at the receipted spine-e baseline (2026-08-26): zero rows clipped on every non-exempt column, so any clipping is a real signal against a clean baseline; a missing allowance fails closed rather than skipping the comparison. private_pension_wealth joined the gated columns with microcosm#1063 (it had been an output without an allowance); the derived totals are clipped like every other column, and a clipped total would also break its identity in the wealth_coherence gate.

Stage-time coherence gate over the WAS wealth receipt (microcosm#1063). Zero rows may carry a main-residence mortgage off the mortgaged tenure or main_residence_value off an owner tenure: both columns are fitted and drawn inside their tenure stratum, so a non-zero count is a defect of the stage, not of a draw; mortgage_debt itself is the main-residence mortgage plus the mortgages on other property, held on any tenure. Every derived total must equal its components on every row (property_wealth, corporate_wealth, gross_financial_wealth, mortgage_debt, and net_financial_wealth as gross less consumer debt and the student loan balance); the stage derives them, so only a support clip of a total can open a gap, and the support gate allows none. The share split and the stocks-and-shares ISA must sum to corporate_wealth, and every debt secured on other property must sit on a held asset of its class, be non-negative, and with the other within the mortgages on other property (share_split_violation_rows, secured_debt_violation_rows; the WAS property draw of microcosm#1095), all written by the stage on the final totals. The weighted share of owner households without a main-residence value may exceed the donor's own share by at most the reviewed excess (the donor's share is zero on the pinned round-8 tab, where every owner reports a value). The receipt's donor comparisons (positive shares by tenure, the mortgaged share owing more than the main-residence value, the mortgage mass held off the mortgaged tenure on each side) and the rows the donor-range cap adjusted are recorded in the details and carry no threshold.

Stage-time support-clip health gate over the WAS Lifetime ISA receipt (microcosm#1003): the balance is drawn from the QRF fitted on the credible donor holders, so every draw lies inside their realised range and non-holders are zero; the zero allowances make any clip a signal.

Stage-time check on the was_lisa ownership anchor (microcosm#1415): WAS round 8 implies about half the Lifetime ISA holders HMRC's 2024-25 subscriptions need, so the stage shifts its ownership logit on ages 18 to 47, the ages that can hold and pay into one in 2024-25, until the weighted holders at those ages the financial-wealth cap leaves equal Table 9.4's Lifetime ISA accounts subscribed to (one subscription a year, so payers). The receipt's realised post-cap holders must sit within maximum_relative_deviation of that target, and a positive shift must remove no holder (the same person-keyed uniforms decide ownership). A target above the largest shift's reach and unshifted holders above the target are named, not failed: the anchor only adds holders. A population fact check: the synthetic smoke records it without blocking.

Stage-time gate over the landlords' receipts and finance costs receipt (microcosm#1106). No row may carry property_rental_income below its property_income: the engine reads such receipts as unknown and withholds the property allowance. No landlord may sit in a receipts band below their own profit. Every PRIS Table 13 band above the lowest holds its share of the spine's landlord weight (the band's share of the individuals-basis landlords) to within its recorded rounding allowance, the weight of the person straddling each of its two boundaries (the walk's whole-person rounding; the lowest band takes the remainder). The open top band's profit multiplier must stay below the declared cap; where the floor at profit already exceeds the band's share of the individuals' Table 2 receipts the multiplier stays at 1 and the overshoot is recorded, not failed. The finance-cost incidence, its realisation by cell, the totals against PRIS, the channel split, the residuals and the coherence share are recorded in the receipt and carry no threshold.

Stage-time support-clip health gate over the NTS bus-travel receipt (microcosm#930): the band is an ordinal the QRF draws inside the donor's 0..6 and the trips are the donor's band means, so no row can clip; the zero allowances make any clip a signal.

Stage-time fact check on the NTS bus-travel receipt (microcosm#930), every published value recomputed from the vendored rows: the frame's prior-weighted share of persons who use a local bus at least yearly against the vendored NTS0313 all-ages share (maximum_user_share_deviation, in points), and the frame's mean local-bus trips per person per series against the vendored NTS0303 rate of the declared year (maximum_trip_rate_deviation, relative). The tolerances are rules set above what a conditional draw on the FRS composition can be expected to reproduce, not observed maxima; the stage runs on a synthetic donor in the smoke build, so the entry is a population fact check that a synthetic smoke records without blocking on. Car availability against NTS0205 is a receipt line, not a check: a mismatch there is a was_wealth finding.

Stage-time realization check over region incidence, latent-rate bands, normalized deduction-type combinations, and the exact latent/type/incidence coherence identity. Tolerances are derived from each receipt cell's realized row count; missing evidence blocks.

Stage-time support-clip health gate over the LCFS receipt. The exempt energy columns are deliberately named here because they are bridged through the NEED/WAS path rather than clipped to LCFS donor support. Allowances pinned at the receipted spine-e baseline (2026-08-26): zero rows clipped on every non-exempt column, so any clipping is a real signal against a clean baseline; a missing allowance fails closed rather than skipping the comparison. Bus fares are clipped before the pricing step (microcosm#890 and #930, María's rulings 2026-09-15 and 2026-09-17): the clip bounds the region no area prices (Wales keeps the chain's raw draw) at donor support, the priced regions then move beyond it as journeys times the published yield, and the column carries no committed terminal support bound.

Stage-time energy check (microcosm#890 F, chronicle#270). María's ruling (2026-09-15, PR #927): 'I'm not sure why we are comparing against NEED as a gate in the first place if that is not what we are calibrating, but I agree we should implement Vahid's recommended fix and move the fix to before calibration.' Fact checks on the lcfs energy_rake receipt, every published value recomputed at gate time from the vendored rows the stage declares: each cell's shape target is the vendored NEED 2024 mean (need_energy_facts.json, margins_period_value), each fuel's level is its declared published level for calendar 2024, the vendored DESNZ Energy Trends domestic consumption at actual temperature over the four quarters (desnz_domestic_energy_facts.json) or, for a fuel the stage declares in spend_level_fuels (electricity, microcosm#1418; gas keeps Energy Trends while ONS 04.5.2 counts bottled gas, María's ruling of 2026-10-29), the kWh the vendored ONS Consumer Trends household spending buys at QEP's United Kingdom average prices once the standing charges of every UK domestic meter DESNZ counts come off (ons_household_expenditure_facts.json), with the level factor equal to that total over the frame's pre-level total and the levelled frame total equal to the published one, each cell's target is shape times factor, and every region with a published gas-connected share (DESNZ subnational gas meters over electricity meters, 2024) sits within 0.5 points of it after the imposition unless the region ran out of households to connect (a receipted shortfall; since microcosm#1164 the stage's declared connect_rule connects zero-gas households, by their donor-modelled probability of paying for gas, in a region the draw leaves short, and the receipt must name the declared rule and salt). The residual check holds the maximum absolute relative deviation of any cell mean from its levelled target, per margin (income band, tenure, property type, region) and fuel, electricity over every household of a cell and gas over its gas-connected households, to one fixed 3.5 % tolerance on the IPF's cross-margin residual (region is swept last and fits to machine precision by construction, so the tolerance binds the earlier three; a declared rule set above the observed maxima, not a fact: spine-s3 on NEED 2023 showed income 1.65 %, tenure 1.29 %, accommodation 0.83 %; spine-s5 on the NEED 2024 shape with the published connection showed income 2.16 % electricity / 1.97 % gas, accommodation 1.46 %, tenure 1.31 %, which is why the 2 % rule of spine-s3 moved to 2.5 %). María's ruling of 2026-10-12 (microcosm#1164, 'Gross band, rule 3.5%') moved it to 3.5 %: with the recipient banded on HBAI gross income, the gross concept NEED and the LCFS donor band on, and the household kWh ceilings, the 2024-25 diary on the K25 spine converged at income 2.40 % electricity and 2.82 % gas before the ceilings and 2.88 % gas after them (accommodation 1.31 %, tenure 1.03 %, region exact). The gap is a cross-margin one: NEED's income-band means imply about 2.5 % more energy for the frame's households than its region means do, while banding on HBAI net income, which converged at 1.4 %, leaves the top income bands so thin that the rake drives about 2 % of gas kWh above the domestic meter limit and the ceilings then leave those cells 3.2 % short. This gate replaced the two NEED mean-spend anchors that uk_aggregate_admin measured on the calibrated frame. The ONS 04.5.1 electricity and 04.5.2 gas rows then held the calibrated frame until microcosm#1113 made them measured diagnostics (María's ruling of 2026-10-08, D1). Since then nothing release-blocking holds domestic energy after calibration: this gate holds its level at prior weights, and the report-only uk_diagnostics.consumption_drift shows how far the weights move it. The gap between the DESNZ-volume-times-QEP-price level the stage sets and the ONS national-accounts spend is the published-source residual PR #927 receipts Part T records, not a gate. microcosm#1418 (María's rulings of 2026-10-28) bound the ONS 04.5.1 row again and moved the stage's electricity level onto it, so the frame's prior-weighted electricity spend starts about 1 % below ONS, the standing charges of the meters that are not frame households. Gas followed, then returned to Energy Trends and its ONS 04.5.2 row to the measure exclusions: the class counts bottled gas, which the frame holds in liquid_fuel_consumption (María's ruling of 2026-10-29, microcosm#1095 tracks the split). Because the gate recomputes the electricity level from the stage's own inputs, it would agree with a wrong input row, so it also holds the ONS-spend level to ons_level_to_energy_trends_ratio of the Energy Trends volume, 0.85 to 1.0 (0.926 on the September 2026 vintage): a wrong ONS class or vintage, or a unit error, that moves it by more than about 8 % fails. ONS's own revisions can move it as far: on the June 2026 vintage (GBP 26.10bn for 2024) the ratio was 0.840, so a re-pin that crosses the bounds asks for the level to be re-adjudicated and is not by itself a data error (Vahid's review of microcosm#1420). Every QEP payment method's level falls inside those bounds (0.882 to 0.970), so the stage's declared payment_method must equal qep_payment_method (all) instead (Anthony's reviews of microcosm#1420). The entry is a population_fact_check: a synthetic smoke build (the staging smoke over the H2 fixture) records its outcome without blocking, because the fixture is not the population NEED, DESNZ and the meter counts describe; every licensed build blocks on it. Tolerance governance (Vahid's third pass on PR #927): maximum_relative_deviation is a rule set above the observed maxima, not a fact; the rake runs a fixed number of sweeps and the receipt now records the cross-margin residual after every sweep (sweep_residuals), so the terminal residual is shown converged, not truncated, and a vintage whose converged residual exceeds the rule is a new ruling for María, never a silent re-pin. The gate checks the convergence rather than asserting it (Vahid's review of microcosm#1012): across the last convergence_window_sweeps (10) sweeps each fuel's residual may range, maximum minus minimum, by at most maximum_residual_change_over_window (0.1 point of relative deviation), so a rake oscillating inside the window fails as a truncated one does; the window presupposes the stage declares more sweeps than the window is long, and the stage refuses an undeclared sweep count. On the licensed spines the 50-sweep receipts of main and of the SPI-first reorder were still falling 0.11 to 0.75 points over their last 10 sweeps, while the 200-sweep receipt of microcosm#1012's final head moves 0.014 points. maximum_connected_share_deviation is declared, not derived from the walk: the greedy weight-fitting walk lands within a fraction of one household weight of the published share, and the check is waived only for a region that runs out of households to connect (the shortfall is receipted with candidates_exhausted and reported here), never for a region above it or one with households left to connect. The regions the crosswalk maps to no subnational area are declared on the stage (connection_fallback_regions, Northern Ireland) and refused if they differ from the crosswalk.

Stage-time fact check on the lcfs bus_pricing receipt (microcosm#930): every area's receipts, boardings, concessionary journeys, trips per resident and population, and the boardings-per-trip and yield factors derived from them, are recomputed from the vendored rows the stage declares and must equal the receipt's; the unpriced regions must be the declared ones (Wales, which keeps the chain's raw draw by María's ruling of 2026-09-17) and the chain must have conditioned on the raw draw. The frame-implied boardings over the published ones are reported per area, not fenced: that ratio is the survey-versus-admin reading the bound receipts targets then act on. A population fact check: the synthetic smoke records it without blocking.

Stage-time check on the lcfs road_fuel_incidence receipt (microcosm#1113): the redraw ran with the declared rule, seed, salt and trees; after it no household the fuel flag marks as buying petrol or diesel carries zero road fuel and no unflagged household carries any; the total model fitted the positive-only regime. The chain's zero share among flagged households is the two-week diary's artefact the step corrects (about a third at prior weights on the 2026-10-08 spine); above one half the chain itself would be at fault, so the gate fails there instead of redrawing it away. María's ruling of 2026-10-08 set every fuel-car household to a positive annual spend. A population fact check: the synthetic smoke records it without blocking.

Stage-time fact check on the lcfs road_fuel_level receipt (microcosm#1113): the ONS Consumer Trends COICOP 07.2.2 household spend the stage declares is recomputed from the vendored row and must equal the receipt's, and the prior-weighted petrol plus diesel after the step must equal it less the donor's other-fuels share, with the factor reproducing that from the drawn total. The other-fuels share is the LCFS donor's own c72213 share of 07.2.2, licensed microdata the gate cannot recompute, so it is bounded at five percent instead (0.46 percent on the 2024-25 diary). María's ruling of 2026-10-08 set the stage, not the weights, as what levels household road fuel. The level is recomputed from the same vendored row the stage read, so the check catches a step that did not apply the declared level; it cannot catch an error in the row itself or a later stage moving the columns. The outside reading is the report-only litres audit against HMRC clearances. A population fact check: the synthetic smoke records it without blocking.

Stage-time check on the lcfs recomposed_totals receipt (microcosm#1113): housing_water_and_electricity_consumption and transport_consumption each keep their own chain draw less the chain's draws of the parts the stage re-levels (the drawn electricity and gas, or the drawn petrol, diesel and bus fares; floored at zero where the parts outgrow the total) and add the levelled parts back, so no household's total is below its electricity and gas, or its petrol, diesel and priced bus fares, and no remainder is negative. The declared parts must be the receipt's, the weighted remainder must equal the drawn total less the drawn parts plus the floored mass, and the weighted total the remainder plus the levelled parts, to the declared tolerance. The step floors the remainder and adds the parts, so on a receipt the declared step wrote these are identities: the check guards the declaration and the receipt, not the size of the totals. The committed support bounds do that, on the emitted frame, through the terminal uk_support gate. The ONS 04.5.3 and 04.5.4 liquid and solid fuel spend no frame column carries is recomputed from the vendored rows and must equal the receipt's; the housing remainder holds the diary's other fuels, which the stage's energy derivation leaves out of electricity and gas (microcosm#1164). A population fact check: the synthetic smoke records it without blocking. Since microcosm#1278 (María's ruling of 2026-10-23) the stage levels the divisions' relative over-draw before the hold, so a recomposed total's remainder is its draw less the drawn parts plus the floored mass, times its recorded levelling factor, which must lie in [0, 1]; the published heating-fuel spend (published_fuels, ONS 04.5.3 and 04.5.4) replaced the uncarried block when the stage began drawing those fuels.

Stage-time fact check on the lcfs excise_quantities and excise_shares receipts (microcosm#1359): every policyengine-uk excise input the stage declares is recomputed from the vendored rows through the stage's own declaration, never taken from the receipt: each alcohol product's FY2024-25 HMRC clearances over the engine's strength, each tobacco product's clearances, each gambling duty base (HMRC's receipts for the duty or Machine Games Duty's liabilities for the band over the engine's rate, and General Betting Duty's base split by the Gambling Commission's gross gambling yield) and the beer and cider draught shares. The receipt's levels must equal them, the prior-weighted frame total of each input must equal its level and the factor must reproduce it from the household spending it is shared by, and an input is positive exactly where that spending is; the basis must be the declared fiscal year over the engine's 52 weeks, and each draught share written must be the published ratio. The three shares the spending comes from (tobacco of P602's off-trade lines, on-trade alcohol of P611, gambling stakes of P609) must have stayed in [0, 1] on the frame and rest on 30 or more donors each, and at most one percent of the donors, by weight, may carry a published total beside a share's diary lines (a share withheld for resting on under ten donors is under it). The levels are recomputed from the same vendored rows the stage read, so the check catches a step that did not apply the declared levels; it cannot catch an error in the rows themselves or a later stage moving the columns. A population fact check: the synthetic smoke records it without blocking.

Stage-time fact check on the lcfs gambling_participation receipt (microcosm#1359): each key's adult participation rates (the National Lottery's products, and the betting and gaming the other gambling duties charge; past four weeks and past twelve months, by sex and age band) are recomputed from the vendored GSGB 2025 rows through the stage's own declaration, never taken from the receipt, and must equal the receipt's, and the receipt's settings (theta per key, the occasional players' stake share, the strata, the propensity classifier, the seed and the salt) must be the declared ones. Per key, each household stratum the receipt gives must sit within maximum_stratum_shortfall of its four-week target and from there of its twelve-month target, or add no household where the diary already passed a target; the national shares must reach the targets less that shortfall; no added household may lack a stake; the three classes' shares of the key's stakes must sum to one; the scale that brings the added regular players' mean stake to the seen households' must lie in amount_scale_bounds, so a broken stake draw that the anchoring would otherwise hide fails (Vahid's review, round 4; the upper bound rose from 2.0 to 2.5 on María's ruling of 2026-10-26, since full spine builds scale the National Lottery's added regular players by about 2.03); the propensity must rest on 30 or more donors; and the excise levelling must have shared the gambling bases by the topped-up keys, each key positive on its twelve-month share. The receipt withholds a stratum with a cell under ten source households, which the gate counts rather than checks; a key withheld nationally fails. The rates are recomputed from the same vendored rows the stage read, so the check catches a step that did not apply the declared rates or settings; it cannot catch an error in the rows themselves, and the stratum targets, which need the frame's adults, are the step's own (it refuses a stratum it cannot fill). A population fact check: the synthetic smoke records it without blocking.

Stage-time check that every household spend column lcfs_consumption emits is at calendar-2024 prices as households paid them (microcosm#1113): the H5's year, which policyengine-uk projects every column from with calendar-year growth and the calibration uprates to the calendar-2025 window, so no column needs a basis of its own. The donor uprating must end at 2024 and carry every diary spend column from the April-to-March diary year, placed on the calendar-year index at three quarters and one quarter: the 2024-25 diary sits a quarter past calendar 2024 and steps back to it (microcosm#1164), and a plain ratio of calendar years would leave it at about fiscal 2024-25 prices. The QEP energy prices and the DESNZ volume level must be for calendar 2024, bus fares must be re-priced to 2024 by the fares indices, and the road-fuel level must be ONS 07.2.2 for calendar 2024; a step whose receipt is absent fails. A population fact check: the synthetic smoke records it without blocking.

Stage-time support-clip health gate over the ETB VAT receipt. Allowances pinned at the receipted spine-e baseline (2026-08-26): zero rows clipped on every non-exempt column, so any clipping is a real signal against a clean baseline; a missing allowance fails closed rather than skipping the comparison.

Stage-time support-clip health gate over the ETB services receipt. Allowances pinned at the receipted spine-e baseline (2026-08-26): zero rows clipped on every non-exempt column, so any clipping is a real signal against a clean baseline; a missing allowance fails closed rather than skipping the comparison. Bus support is exempt since microcosm#890: the declared rake to the published net support sets its level. Since microcosm#930 (María's ruling of 2026-09-23 retiring the support rake) bus_subsidy_spending is clipped like the other two columns before the pricing step overrides it outside Wales and Northern Ireland, so it carries the same zero allowances and is no longer exempt.

Stage-time fact check on the ETB bus-support pricing receipt (microcosm#930; the #890 rake to the published net support retired on María's ruling of 2026-09-23): every declared support area's concessionary travel reimbursement, net support, boardings and concessionary boardings (DfT BUS05bi and BUS01 for London and England outside London, Scottish Transport Statistics for Scotland) and the per-boarding rates derived from them are recomputed from the vendored rows through the stage's own declaration and must equal the receipt's; the raw-draw regions (Wales, Northern Ireland) must be the declared ones and the pricing must be applied on the chain's raw draw. The priced support against the published net support is reported, not fenced: the calibration targets act on it. A population fact check: the synthetic smoke records it without blocking.

Stage-time source-signal gate over the retained FRS/HMRC leaves receipt. hmrc_spi_incapacity_benefit_income is the E7 reviewed-absent adjudication (microcosm#683, 2026-08-18): the FRS 2024-25 source carries no incapacity-benefit signal, the stage's own fence raises at build time if a future vintage does, and the reviewed list here makes the battery agree with that adjudication instead of re-litigating it every build.

Stage-time gate over the annual income descriptors' receipt: every share lies in [0, 1], no other-spell amount is negative and every full-year earner keeps the whole year, exactly; the usual-to-DV pay ratio the stage measures lies in [0.95, 1.10]; annual employee earners are between one and 1.15 times current ones (the survey's spells add part-year earners and cannot remove a current one); and, where ten or more households carry it, at least 0.7 of the pay outside the current job is observed rather than drawn from a donor.
Stage-time mass gate over the SPI support-channel receipt: the channel's prior share of households without a member at or over State Pension age, and its share of those with one (microcosm#1069).
Stage-time SPI redraw identity gate over the HMRC SPI income spine receipt.

Stage-time structural gate over the SPI benefit coherence receipt (microcosm#1095, uk-data#514): no SPI-channel row keeps a zeroed legacy report, every restored report equals the FRS twin's, receives_benefits_in_own_right agrees with each person's own reports, FRS rows are unchanged, every SPI benefit unit with a Universal Credit reporter claims, and no SPI unit outside the Universal Credit age population claims without reporting.

Stage-time gate over the Universal Credit take-up receipt (microcosm#1334): every reporter claims and no unit outside the draw changes; in each DWP family type the pools whose target is reachable realize DWP's calendar-2025 caseload within 0.055 of it at the stage's weights, Great Britain only, counting units the engine moves off their legacy benefits at their expected claim at the closure; and the family type's caseload is no further from DWP's than before the redraw, give or take 0.055 of DWP's count. The tolerance was 0.05 until microcosm#1418: routing gilt interest out of dividend_income reshuffles the SPI channel's draws. In the savings follow-up (microcosm#1428), small upstream changes moved single people's GBP 1,000 to 1,100 band into a pool whose DWP count exceeds its entitled units, and the family type's caseload ended 0.0568, then 0.0674, of DWP's count further from it than before the redraw. The stage now joins a pool that cannot meet its count to the adjacent pool with more room for its gap, so a family type's caseload lands on DWP's wherever its entitled units allow, and the tolerance stays at 0.055 (María's ruling of 2026-10-31). The terminal take-up signal gate no longer measures would_claim_uc, whose rate is now set by award band and family type, not as one share of the age population.

Stage-time gate over the Pension Credit take-up receipt (microcosm#1069 R9): each component band (Guarantee Credit, Savings Credit only) realizes its DWP FYE 2024 caseload take-up within 0.05 at the stage's weights, or at least the rate where its reporters alone exceed it. The terminal take-up signal gate no longer measures would_claim_pc, whose rate is a share of the entitled units the engine finds, not of every benefit unit.

Stage-time gate over the Child Benefit take-up receipt (microcosm#1063): the share of eligible children claimed for is within 0.02 of HMRC's published claim rates by single year of age (Table 15, May 2025) at the frame's age mix, and within 0.05 at each age with at least 200 child rows whose solved rate was not clipped (clipped ages are reported); the opted-out share of claiming families is within 0.01 of the published opted-out share of registered families (August 2025), or below it only where the charged families are exhausted. The terminal take-up signal gate no longer measures would_claim_child_benefit or child_benefit_opts_out, whose rates are shares of eligible children and of claiming families, not of every benefit unit.
Stage-time conservation gate over the CGT incidence clone receipt.

Stage-time gate over the high-value home support receipt (microcosm#1240 fix 1). Total household mass is conserved to the declared deviation; the receipt restates the ruled stratum (owner households at or above the 0.95 weighted rank of main_residence_value within their region) and copy count (6); every region with owner households selects at least one; copies created equal five per selected household. The stage assigns no value and makes no draw, so it holds no distributional threshold.

Stage-time gate over the CGT support split receipt (microcosm#1045). Total household mass is conserved to the declared deviation; every copy weighs at most the declared maximum; each income column's support mass equals clone_split_factor x headroom x the published count of gainers at or above GBP 250,000 in that column; the selected mass covers the support mass unless the column's pool is exhausted, in which case the whole pool is selected and the exhaustion is recorded rather than refused (five of six columns exhaust on the synthetic smoke fixture). The split supplies row support at the top of the gains distribution for the Table 3 redraw and assigns no value, so it holds no distributional threshold.

Stage-time support gate for spi_income_band_donors (PolicyEngine/chronicle#280 lane; mass-conserving since microcosm#1063): every HMRC Table 2.5 band from GBP 200,000 carries reserved donor households with one carrier each at equal positive weight no greater than the declared maximum, and the bands are exactly the declared four. The donors' mass is reallocated from the households of each donor's region: total household mass is conserved to the declared deviation and no region's incumbents are scaled below the declared funding factor. At full scale every band seats its planned count (never fewer than the minimum) and carries its published taxpayers to the declared deviation; a full-sample build must be at full scale, and a small frame records its seating and mass scales instead.
Stage-time CGT redraw summary gate wired through the existing UKCGTImputationSummary receipt rather than fabricating a terminal support verdict.

Stage-time gate over the CGT residential split receipt (microcosm#1063). The split carries the solved residential probability as weight: every household with liable gainers becomes arms whose weights are products of p and 1 - p, one arm per subset of residential gainers, the arm with no residential gainer keeping the household's ids. Total household mass is conserved to the declared deviation; the logistic solve reproduces the Table 8a 2024-25 totals on the individuals basis within the solve tolerance; the residential count and gains at design weights equal the solved expectations in every HMRC gain band to the identity tolerance (an arithmetic identity, not a realisation); every arm weight is its declared product; the arms created match the households by liable gainers; and no household carries more liable gainers than the declared maximum. The details carry the arm-weight distribution and the share of the residential gains on the largest arm stakes.

Stage-time gate over the CGT asset-type receipt (microcosm#725, #1014): the residential arms the cgt_residential_split stage left carry the Table 8a 2024-25 totals on the individuals basis at design weights within the solve tolerance (microcosm#1063 carries the solved residential probability as weight, so nothing is drawn here and no walk bound applies), and every gain band row of the residential receipt is finite and sums to the receipt. Each Table 4.1 2024-25 BADR band is held to deterministic bounds only: its solve to the band's published claimant count and qualifying gains (the open top band to the published gains over the lifetime limit), its realised count within the band pool's largest weight, its realised qualifying gains within that weight times (2 max gain - min gain) of the band pool below the limit and exactly the limit times the realised count in the top band; every BADR invariant (claimants outside the non-residential liable pool, qualifying gains above the net gain or the limit or outside the band, residential overlap, sub-AEA claimants) must be zero and the main-type fits (one per claimant status since microcosm#1063) must have converged. Every liable gainer carries an asset type and the Table 7 composition receipt is finite; the calibration binds the residential totals and the Table 4.1 bands.

Stage-time gate over the CGT incidence anchor receipt (microcosm#970). Clone-side receipt: the groups, targets and masses are clone households paired to originals; band donors and originals are outside the anchor, so this gate certifies the anchor's own arithmetic against its declared composition, not a population count. The sub-exempt and loss-making clone groups sit at the reporter-composition targets derived from the redrawn liable mass whenever they were trimmed, never overshoot or gain mass, and stay untouched when already at or below target; zero-gain clone carriers are no reporters and are left untouched; liable clone mass is byte-identical before and after; every clone/original pair conserves its mass to floating-point rounding; the clone side never exceeds the original side; and at least one pair exists. The level is a modelling assumption (HMRC publishes no count below the exempt amount), so the gate fixes the anchor to its own declared composition rather than to a published target.
Stage-time realization gate over salary_sacrifice's own headcount receipt.

Stage-time gate over the per-plan student-loan top-up receipts (microcosm#1049). The stage realises each plan's shortfall against the pinned SLC liable stock by an identity-keyed greedy walk: eligible persons in ascending stable-uniform order, taken when their weight fits inside the remaining shortfall, skipped when it would overshoot, and the skipped person nearest the remainder taken afterwards if that brings the realised mass nearer the shortfall (the gas-connection walk's rule). The gate checks what the walk controls: the realised top-up sits within the lightest skipped person's weight of the shortfall, and the plan's final England count within maximum_stock_relative_deviation (5 percent) of the stock. A pool lighter than the shortfall must have been taken whole, and its attainment is recorded rather than refused: on the licensed spine PLAN_2's eligible pool holds about 2.0m people against a 7.5m shortfall (final England count 3.4m against the 8.94m stock), a gap between what the SLC liable stock counts and what the FRS carries that the stage cannot close. A plan already at or above its stock is left as reported and recorded. Every receipt field is required and the receipt must be self-consistent, so a partial or tampered receipt fails closed. This replaces a relative-deviation check on a Bernoulli increment, which refused every spine since #1006: PLAN_5's shortfall had shrunk to 817 people, about one survey person's weight, so the draw's outcome of zero or two rows was off by around 100 percent whichever way it fell (1.10 against the 1.0 rule), while the final count (10,901 against 10,000) was acceptable and unchecked. The synthetic smoke build over the H2 fixture cannot reach either stock and records both pools as exhausted.

Stage-time achieved-versus-target gate over the age-tail disaggregation receipt. At its post-frs_spine position, achieved_weighted measures raw FRS-grossed 80+ mass before clone or zero-weight support channels exist.

Stage-time invariants over the #791 relationship receipt: exactly one HEAD per household agreeing with hrpid and hrpnum, contiguous person numbers, no person with two partners, no unmapped relhrp code, family index and enum domains consistent, and the ten-cell household-type partition covering every household exactly once. The grid reciprocity tolerance is the reviewed 2024-25 tape count; a re-issued tape with a different count refuses for review.

Stage-time gate over the regional home-values receipt (microcosm#1308, gated with the next policyengine-uk bump on María's ruling of 2026-10-17): every English region and Wales has rows re-ranked on the regional knots, no more rows are rewritten than the stage carries, no source sits at the value cap, the knots are the 2024 basis and the ranking is the weighted midpoint within each FRS region, and the weighted value stays positive before and after the stage. A synthetic smoke build records a failure without blocking on it (population_fact_check): the fixture holds a few regions, not the population the regional knots describe.

Stage-time gate over the property purchases receipt (microcosm#1308, gated with the next policyengine-uk bump on María's ruling of 2026-10-17): the additional-dwelling and non-residential kinds are each drawn once; each draws HMRC's Stamp Tax transactions within 5 percent (the events are drawn, so the count is near, not exact); each fits HMRC's value less its recorded shortfall, which may not pass one fifth, the floor the stage itself refuses below; and the individuals' shares of HMRC's all-buyers totals are proper shares. A synthetic smoke build records a failure without blocking on it (population_fact_check): the fixture sizes its own targets to its few households and carries none of HMRC's published shares.

Stage-time gate over the Move to UC take-up receipt (microcosm#1308, gated with the next policyengine-uk bump on María's ruling of 2026-10-17). The receipt withholds what a thin combination realizes, so the gate holds the contract it can read: the share is measured at the spine's design weights over Great Britain, every combination's rate is a probability taken from its combination or from all households, its support is a printed band, its unreachable flag is a boolean, a withheld "<10" or absent, and the share claiming at closure is a share or withheld.

Stage-time gate over the is_apprentice receipt (microcosm#1373). The draw's target is the contract's apprentice_stock_19_to_24 for the build year (DfE's England apprentices in learning at the start of the academic year, participation less starts, per head aged 19 to 24) times the weighted population aged 21 to 24 at the stage's weights, and eligible employees aged 21 to 24 are flagged in the order of their identity-keyed uniform until their weight is nearest it, so the stage misses it by at most half one person's weight. The gate checks that the receipt carries the contract's rate under the declared key, that its target is that rate times its population, that its support is printed in bands, and, unless the eligible employees weigh no more than the target (cap-bound, every one of them flagged), that the flagged weight lies within maximum_relative_realization_deviation (5 percent) of the target. That tolerance is a declared rule set above the half-weight bound, not a fact. A figure resting on fewer than ten source households, which the receipt withholds under the UKDS disclosure rule and prints "<10", is named unchecked, never failed: a small-cell rule never stops a build (María's ruling of 2026-10-26). The receipt also records the relief the flags imply at the installed engine's own Class 1 schedule for the build year (on a 2024 frame, 13.8 percent between GBP 9,100 and GBP 50,270), with each flagged employee's pay standing in for NIC earnings, and the gate holds it at or below maximum_implied_relief: GBP 370m, HMRC's NIC - NS1 for 2024-25 (tax relief statistics, January 2026, Table 2), which covers every apprentice under 25, under-21s included, since the apprentice relief takes precedence (Vahid's review of microcosm#1373, S1). It is a ceiling, not a target. The stage refuses an installed engine without the s.9B threshold or without policyengine-uk#2683's split of the apprentice minimum wage from the flag. The entry is a population_fact_check, so the synthetic smoke build over the H2 fixture records its outcome without blocking; every licensed build blocks on it.

Stage-time rules of the isa_subscriptions receipt that hold for any population (microcosm#1415, review of microcosm#1421). It fails on any record the receipt counts against them (a non-finite value; cash, stocks and shares and Lifetime ISA payments over GBP 20,000; a Lifetime ISA payment over GBP 4,000; a subscriber under 18; a payment into a type the person does not hold; a both-type subscriber missing a part; a negative amount) and on person balances that miss the household was_wealth draws by more than maximum_household_sum_error_gbp. It is no population fact check, so the synthetic smoke build blocks on it as every licensed build does; the comparisons with HMRC's tables are uk_stage_isa_subscriptions.

Stage-time check of the isa_subscriptions receipt against HMRC's tables (microcosm#1415). It fails on the 2024-25 cash and stocks-and-shares totals off Table 9.4's 2024-25 amounts (María's ruling of 29 October 2026), the both-type split's stocks-and-shares residual or the Lifetime ISA total off its Table 9.4 amount by more than maximum_relative_total_deviation; a reported saturation is named, not failed. Cells short of eligible holders are named, never failed: the stage invents no holders, and the distance from HMRC's tables after calibration is measured, not gated (María's ruling of 28 October 2026). A population fact check: the synthetic smoke records it without blocking, since a synthetic population cannot reach HMRC's national totals; the rules any population must keep are uk_stage_isa_subscriptions_invariants.
The release input-coverage contract over the built frame: required columns present and populated per the committed manifest resource in this package.

No constant non-structural columns on any entity table. Reviewed exclusions come from the committed schema-2 register (the microcosm#630 source-year adjudication landed there via microcosm#658, approval receipt with expiry included); the battery runs the same policy of record the terminal report resolves.

The microcosm#630 finding-2 breach (1590.53) was adjudicated NOT a re-baseline case: adversarial decomposition showed 11-12 SPI-synthetic clone rows from two donor lineages carried pathological inherited weights, fixed upstream by the per-stratum allocation in microcosm#710 (post-fix full-scale ratio well inside this fence). The fence held and stays at the June bound; raising it requires an explicit future adjudication with a receipted measurement, never loosen-to-pass. Every fit-produced weight column carries a completed audit record. Armed by the SPI income stage; an absent audit is not a passing audit — and blocks every posture, not only release candidates: the legacy schema-3 path's strictness, ported during the #654 retirement (microcosm#691 review).
Every UK source-stage column declared in source_stages.json nonnegative_outputs must be finite and non-negative on the terminal frame; this makes the shared nonnegative column gate live for UK.

Benunit-aggregated reported Universal Credit must imply would_claim_uc. Both recorded capitals, uc_reported_capital and pension_credit_reported_capital, are bounded below by the named -1 unavailable sentinel and may use it only where the FRS carrier frs_benunit_capital is unavailable. Otherwise each equals the carrier plus the household property the unit holds, re-derived here with the stage's own rule (microcosm#1095): the household reference person's benefit unit holds the household's property at 90% of its value, market value less 10% for the costs of sale, less the debt secured on it class by class and floored at zero per class (UC Regs 2013 reg 49(1)(b); SPC Regs 2002 reg 19(b); the WAS property draw of microcosm#1095, owned land carrying none), and no other unit holds any. UC counts other residential and non-residential property, and a unit that reports Universal Credit keeps its receipt and carries none; Pension Credit counts those and owned land. The sum may differ by GBP 0.01 plus one float32 step of the expected value, so a float32 round-trip of the export does not fail it. No unit may sit on the -1 sentinel beside a unit that records a property share for either scheme: since policyengine-uk 2.136.1 the sentinel unit would take its own share of property the recording unit already holds, so the engine would count it twice (Vahid's review of microcosm#1333).

Every WAS/LCFS/ETB imputed output covered by support clipping must remain inside committed disclosure-safe donor support bounds. Exact donor ranges are used in-run for clipping; this release gate uses outward-rounded reviewed bounds so unit-record donor minima and maxima are never committed. The nts_bus_travel person outputs (band and annual trips) are bounded by the NTS donor's ranges since microcosm#930. The was_lisa person balance is bounded by the WAS person donor's credible holders since microcosm#1003. Since microcosm#1240 the dense graph rewrites main_residence_value and property_wealth per clone from the Land Registry value knots, winsorised at the knots' declared cap; price_paid_property_support_bounds.json, generated beside the knots, carries that cap as the two columns' bound and is listed last so it overrides the WAS donor bound for them.

Release-blocking aggregate-admin gate for the NHS budget. The two NEED energy anchors left this gate under microcosm#890 by María's ruling (2026-09-15, PR #927): 'I'm not sure why we are comparing against NEED as a gate in the first place if that is not what we are calibrating, but I agree we should implement Vahid's recommended fix and move the fix to before calibration.' NEED is checked where the rake acts, at prior weights, by uk_stage_lcfs_consumption_energy_rake. From chronicle #271 the calibrated frame was held to the bound ONS 04.5.1 electricity and 04.5.2 gas rows; microcosm#1113 made both measured diagnostics (María's ruling of 2026-10-08, D1), and held obr.vat and obr.fuel_duties_cars out of the fit with them (D3, D2). Since microcosm#1418 the bound ONS 04.5.1 row holds calibrated household electricity spend again, while the gas row stays a measured diagnostic (microcosm#1095), and the bound ons.household_road_fuel_expenditure row holds household road-fuel spend; no bound row holds the VAT base or fuel duty, and no release-blocking check holds any of them after calibration, and the report-only uk_diagnostics.consumption_drift shows the levelled totals at design and final weights. Known and unchecked after calibration since microcosm#890: the calibrated NEED means sat at GBP 824 / 688 against the anchors' GBP 1,082 / 850 (-24 % / -19 %) because NEED kWh priced at the FY2024-25 cap (about GBP 52bn at design weights) and ONS 04.5 (GBP 43.4bn) disagree by roughly 20 % on this frame (PR #927 receipts Parts N-Q). The build supplies SDC-safe measured aggregates as evidence; the gate checks signs and tolerances.

gates.notes: Reviewed candidate-only fields from the June UK prototype (source provenance or genuine additional model inputs, not incumbent-surface losses), with household.uses_energy_prepayment_meter added for microcosm#1110 (the LCFS prepayment-meter flag policyengine-uk reads from 2.123.3 for the Energy Price Guarantee prepayment discount; an older engine ignores it, and the incumbent does not carry it until uk-data#539), the LCFS excise step's 24 household inputs added for microcosm#1359 (alcohol litres and the beer and cider draught shares, tobacco a week and the gambling duty bases; policyengine-uk reads the alcohol and tobacco ones from 2.145.0 and the gambling ones from 2.151.0, an older engine ignores them, and the incumbent carries none) plus the reviewed reference-side exclusions (the all-zero incapacity benefit layer and the formula-owned property_wealth total, microcosm#1106; the formula-owned tax_free_savings_income total, whose ISA interest the candidate stores apart under the additive ISA income contract, microcosm#1360). The two hard-required columns that may never be waived stay a code-level guard, per the microcosm#327 rule that a parity comparison's registers are declared inputs. During the migration window the runtime merges the exclusion register with the legacy constant and the spec-pin tests hold the two equal; the register becomes solely load-bearing when the constant retires.

Every contract-driven stochastic flag must be non-constant and have a weighted share within +/-0.05 of its contract target. would_claim_pc is measured by uk_stage_pension_credit_take_up instead (microcosm#1069 R9), would_claim_child_benefit and child_benefit_opts_out by uk_stage_child_benefit_take_up (microcosm#1063), and would_claim_uc by uk_stage_uc_take_up (microcosm#1334): frs_take_up and spi_benefit_coherence draw it at the contract rate, and uc_take_up redraws every entitled unit by award band and family type. would_claim_universal_childcare is nested under would_claim_extended_childcare, so its target is the nested marginal r_e + (1 - r_e) * r_u of the contract's conditional universal rate, and the gate fails on any benefit unit that claims the extended hours without the universal ones. max_free_entitlement_hours_used carries the under-2 usage draw: its share of persons with hours is measured over the children of DfE age 0 or 1 in units that claim the extended hours, against the weighted mean of their ages' contract rates (extended_childcare_age_0_usage, extended_childcare_age_1_usage), within +/-0.10: the DfE working-parent row at 9 to 11 months binds a thin cell of that draw's children, so the calibrated weights move the share from its rates where the spine's own weights hold it to them (ruling of 2026-10-25); tools/report_uk_childcare_realised_take_up.py records the share a file realises.

Take-up signal stays terminal by contrast, because its weighted shares are not the same statistic before and after calibration.

Each household's council-tax band must be one its nation uses: A-H in England and Scotland, A-I in Wales, and only the FRS placeholder D in Northern Ireland, which pays domestic rates (microcosm#1278). The engine enum holds A-I for every nation, so its domain alone passes a band I in England: no English target counts that band, and a computed council tax would charge it at the Band D ratio. The nation comes from the household region through the region tier, and the declared domains must equal UK_COUNCIL_TAX_BANDS_BY_NATION. Its parameters must equal the spine entry's.
Every activated UK national target reference must resolve and enter the calibration matrix; count mismatch blocks release.

The solve's realized target surface must equal the declared register exactly, at name-and-period grain; the gate takes no tunable parameters. The reference side is the declared register, not an incumbent-derived surface — the frozen parity instrument carries input-column shares only — so this proves that every declared target was bound at its declared period, not agreement with the incumbent.
Every calibration target within twenty-five percent absolute relative error, the certified June acceptance bound.

Projection fence over the calibrated frame's sub-exempt gainers (microcosm#970). The engine freezes the annual exempt amount at its nominal value and uprates capital_gains by OBR per-capita GDP growth, so a gainer at or just below the exempt amount in the build period becomes a CGT taxpayer in a later projected year without any change in behaviour. For every year to the horizon the gate counts the cumulative stock of build-period sub-exempt gainers (gains in (0, exempt amount]) whose gains, uprated by the cumulative growth factor to that year, exceed that year's exempt amount; the stock is non-decreasing in the year, so the horizon year carries the largest count. The bound is the vendored HMRC Table 2.1a count of 2024-25 taxpayers with gains from 3,000 to 5,999 (73,000): people already above the exempt amount, not entrants, so the bound is a plausibility ceiling (the population of the thinnest liable band), not a published entrant count. The horizon 2030 was the last year of the OBR per-capita growth path in the engine's parameter tree, so a longer horizon would only have compounded a constant; since policyengine-uk 2.164.1 the October 2026 path runs to 2031 and later years repeat the 2031 rate, so a 2031 horizon would add one more year of growth to the count. The growth path and the exempt amount by year the seam reads from the installed engine are pinned here and drift-checked (the exempt amount was 6,000 in 2023-24 and 3,000 from 2024-25, so a 2023-period frame's base year reads 6,000), so an engine bump cannot move the verdict silently and re-pinning is a reviewed change (re-pinned at the policyengine-uk 2.161.0 lock: from 2.155.0 the engine takes population growth from the OBR's March 2026 determinants, microcosm#1095; and at the 2.164.2 lock for the OBR's October 2026 outlook, microcosm#1415); without an installed engine the seam builds the projection from these pins and the receipt says so. The margin is thin by construction: on the first rebuilt candidate the stock ran from 12.7k in 2025 to 67.6k in 2030, about 13k a year, and 61k of the 67.6k were band donors the redraw had demoted below the exempt amount, a separate decision; the anchored clones contributed 6.4k. The v20 candidate would have failed with 10.8 million in the first projected year. The bound comes from the same vendored facts the amounts stage is pinned to, never from a literal.

efrs-post-calibration.scope_note: Channel-blind post-calibration enhanced-FRS production incumbent, pinned to the 2024-25 line; its artifact carries the SPI-synthetic rows structurally but no admin-restored mass in the SPI-channel-exclusive columns, so those columns are comparable only through per-reference reviewed exclusions.

gates.notes: Weighted input-mass parity against the active named reference in the registry, with reviewed exclusions scoped per reference so a channel-blind reference exclusion does not suppress comparison against a future channel-aware reference. The tolerance is the worst surviving measured drift at the reviewed floor, exact, with no headroom; the reviewed per-reference exclusions (charitable_investment_gifts, signed at +15,168.8% on the post-#710 surface; owned_land, signed for seed variance) were retired on 2026-09-22 when the first release-cut certification measured both inside the fence (-99.0% and -73.5% against the enhanced FRS reference, microcosm#967); the register is empty and the gate's current failures are the two genuine breaches it names. The 0.0 floor excludes only arithmetically meaningless zero-mass denominators. Totals stay uncommitted under the UKDS licence, supplied per-run and pinned by totals_sha256; missing sidecar evidence records evidence_absent. Totals keys are flat frame column names since the #611 A4 dedup; that digest re-freeze was keys-only against the #610 values (identity unchanged, values byte-identical). Sensitivity floor, recorded rather than silent (microcosm#706 review): the tolerance is the worst surviving measured drift, and that edge is currently set by a column whose deviation is explained (vintage plus SPI composition, microcosm#703's head-to-head receipt), so at this value the gate is a gross mass-loss/explosion fence rather than a regression detector — the compared population sits at median 0.24 and p90 0.63. Tightening runs through this register: each explained top drift that earns a receipt lets the tolerance re-mint at the worst unexplained survivor, with the full distribution and the exclusions-versus-tolerance tradeoff in experiments/630-uk-gate-adjudication-receipts.md.
The existing UK geography-ladder evaluator is rerun on the locally calibrated candidate weights and adapted through UKGateBinding; no second ladder verdict implementation is introduced.

The post-geography node uk.full.geography.brma rewrites household brma from the assigned LSOA or output area after the spine's assembled enum check (microcosm#1262). Recheck the local candidate against the PolicyEngine-UK brma enum domain before export: an invalid value or missing domain evidence is structural and stops even a development build. A separate local entry keeps the assembled spine declaration, and the spine checkpoint identity it feeds, unchanged.

Both local grains are blocking from birth. Each declared area needs at least 50 positive-weight rows, Kish ESS 50, and 50 distinct positive-weight source households. A reviewed exclusion, keyed local_authority/<code> or constituency/<code>, excuses its area's floor miss and is gate-only (microcosm#1301): it defers none of the area's cells, so signing an area leaves the solve unchanged; the Isles of Scilly and City of London cell deferrals are the local reference generator's own constants, lockstep-tested against this register. An exclusion records the floors its area misses, never the area's figures; a stale, expired or not-yet-in-force exclusion fails and must be retired or renewed, and one scoped to another release line stands aside. The constituency K=4 receipt measured minima of 101 rows, ESS 86.4, and 97 sources; a local-authority miss reopens K or requires a separately reviewed exclusion.

Every bound target must be within 25% absolute relative error. Release-blocking following PR #870 review; the numeric threshold is unchanged. A breaching cell may stand on a reviewed exclusion in local_target_fit_reviewed_exclusions.json, keyed by the gate's family/area_code/metric cell name (microcosm#1301): the exclusion lifts this fence only, the cell stays bound in the solve, and a stale, expired or not-yet-in-force entry fails on the build's review date.

Each bound family of at least five rows needs at least half within 25%; the within-10% share remains diagnostic. Release-blocking following PR #870 review; existing evaluator thresholds and family-size policy are unchanged.

Maximum-to-median positive weight ratio must not exceed 100.0. Release-blocking following PR #870 review; the numeric threshold is unchanged. Evaluated on family-folded weights since microcosm#1045 (each geographic clone with its own cgt_support_split copies summed; the geographic clone index keeps the K clones apart), with the row-level summary reported beside it.

Effective sample size must be at least 0.01 of rows. Release-blocking following PR #870 review; the numeric threshold is unchanged. Evaluated on family-folded weights since microcosm#1045 (each geographic clone with its own cgt_support_split copies summed; the geographic clone index keeps the K clones apart), with the row-level summary reported beside it.

microcosm#1240 fix 8, report-only. On the calibrated pool: England owner-occupied homes by surcharge band at April-2026 prices beside the OBR costing note's Table 1.1 (every residential property in scope, 2028-29; shown with the note's non-owner-occupied share, never bound); the regional split of homes over 2m beside the derived Land Registry stock; and the Spearman rank correlation by constituency of homes over 1.5m and over 2m against the derived stock and VOA band H. For every constituency and local authority where the derived stock places at least 100 owner-occupied homes over 1.5m or over 2m, the pool must carry at least 10 distinct source households above the threshold with no source household above half of the cell (the UKDS disclosure floor the Budget-day outputs apply).
